release_notes.en-US:
The session list opens instantly on large profiles, plus quality-of-life fixes.

Speed
- The session list now appears in a fraction of a second even with thousands of sessions (it could sit blank for several seconds before). Search is ready almost immediately.
- The first time you open the list after this update, TS-G may show "Optimizing your sessions…" for a few seconds while it prepares. This happens once.

Improvements
- Add several tags at once: separate them with commas, e.g. "work, research, reading". Undo removes them all in one step.
- The undo/redo buttons show how many steps are available as a small badge, and in their tooltip.
- Changing the date format or the open-button setting updates an open session list straight away.

Fixes
- Backups: if a session's backup file couldn't be saved, it was silently skipped from then on. It's now retried on the next backup.
